info.name: Nursery Management System (NMS) API
info.description:
Postman collection for the Nursery Management System backend (Spring Boot).

**Base URL** is controlled by the `baseUrl` variable (default `http://localhost:8080`).

**Two-layer SaaS model**
- **Super Admin** (platform owner / DiscoverDev): provisions new nurseries and invites their first admin(s). Not attached to any nursery. The bootstrap account is a super admin.
- **Admin** (nursery manager): scoped to a single nursery. Configures nursery setup, creates rooms, invites teachers/parents — and can also invite additional admins within their own nursery.
- **Teacher / Parent**: invited by an admin of their nursery.

**Auth model**
- Access tokens (JWT) carry `sub`, `email`, and `role` and **do not expire**. Revocation happens server-side by setting `User.enabled = false` (`Admin / Users / Disable User`).
- Refresh tokens exist for compatibility but are optional.
- "Logout" is a frontend concern — discard the access token client-side. The backend `/api/auth/logout` only revokes refresh tokens.

**End-to-end flow**
1. `Auth / Login` as the bootstrap super admin → access token saved.
2. `Super Admin / Create Nursery` → saves `{{nurseryId}}`.
3. `Super Admin / Invite Admin` for that nursery → saves `{{inviteToken}}`.
4. `Auth / Accept Invite` (the invited admin sets a password and is immediately logged in).
5. The admin runs `Admin / Nursery / Update Nursery` → `Update Geofence` → `Admin / Rooms / Create Room` → `Admin / Invites / Create Invite` to onboard teachers and parents.

**Bootstrap super admin (dev defaults from application.yml)**
- email: `admin@nms.local`
- password: `ChangeMe!123`

**Roles**: `SUPER_ADMIN`, `ADMIN`, `TEACHER`, `PARENT`. **Locales**: `EN`, `AR`.

item.name: Super Admin
item.description: Platform-level endpoints. Only accessible to users with role `SUPER_ADMIN` — the bootstrap account is one. Super admins are not attached to any nursery; they provision new nurseries and onboard their first admin(s).

request.description:
Provisions a new nursery (tenant). Body has just `name` (1–200 chars); the nursery starts with default timezone `Africa/Cairo` and geofence radius 100m. The first admin will fill in the rest via `Admin / Nursery / Update Nursery` after they accept their invite.

**Response (201)** is the full nursery shape. The test script auto-saves the new id into `{{nurseryId}}`.
Returns every nursery on the platform, ordered by name. Super-admin-only.
Fetch a single nursery by id. Returns 404 if not found.
Rename a nursery. Operational details (logo, hours, geofence) are owned by the nursery's admin via `Admin / Nursery / Update Nursery`.

Invite the first admin (or any additional admin) for the target nursery. Role is forced to `ADMIN`; the invited user is auto-attached to the nursery in the URL.

**Body**
- `email` (required, valid email, max 254)
- `fullName` (required, max 200)
- `locale` (optional) — `EN` or `AR`, defaults to `EN`.
- `phone` (optional, max 32)

**Response (201)** has the same shape as `Admin / Invites / Create Invite`. The test script saves `{{inviteToken}}` and `{{userId}}` so the chain into `Auth / Accept Invite` just works.

Returns 404 if the nursery id is unknown, 409 if the email already exists in the system.

Authenticate with email + password. Used by **all roles** (super admin, admin, teacher, parent). The role embedded in the returned JWT determines which endpoints the user can access.

Returns:
- `accessToken` — JWT, no expiry. Send as `Authorization: Bearer ...` on protected endpoints.
- `refreshToken` — opaque, 14-day TTL. Optional under the current model.
- `tokenType` — `Bearer`.
- `expiresInSeconds` — informational only; access tokens do not expire on time.

Fails with 401 if the user is disabled or the credentials are wrong, and with a friendly message if the account exists but has not yet accepted its invite (no password set).

**Bootstrap super admin (dev)**: `admin@nms.local` / `ChangeMe!123`.

Exchange a refresh token for a new access/refresh token pair (rotation: the old refresh token is revoked).

Optional under the current auth model — access tokens do not expire on time, so you typically only need refresh after `POST /api/auth/logout` or after an admin disables and re-enables the user.

Revokes the current user's refresh tokens. Requires a valid access token.

**Note**: this does NOT invalidate the access token itself (JWT is stateless and never expires). For real revocation, use `Admin / Disable User` or have the frontend discard the token.
Returns the currently authenticated user's profile: `id`, `email`, `fullName`, `role`, `locale`. Useful for the frontend to render role-aware UI without decoding the JWT.

Activate an invited user by setting their password. Marks the invite as used, sets `enabled = true`, and returns a fresh token pair so the new user is logged in immediately.

Fails with 401 if the invite is unknown, already used, or expired (default 48h).

Initiates the password reset flow. Always returns 204 — even for unknown emails — to avoid email enumeration.

In dev, the generated token is logged to the server console (look for `Password reset token issued for ...`). Copy it into the `passwordResetToken` collection variable, then call `Auth / Reset Password`.

Completes a password reset using the token issued by the forgot-password flow. On success, sets the new password and revokes all refresh tokens for that user (existing access tokens remain valid until the user is disabled — frontend should drop them).

Fails with 401 if the token is unknown, already used, or expired.

item.name: Nursery
item.description: Endpoints for the admin to read and update their own nursery (name, logo, hours, geofence). Every admin is scoped to a single nursery via `User.nursery_id`; these endpoints implicitly target the caller's nursery.

request.description: Returns the current admin's nursery: id, name, logo, timezone, opening hours, geofence center+radius. Useful as the first call after login to populate the admin dashboard header and settings.

Partial update of nursery profile. Any field may be omitted; only provided fields are changed.

`hoursStart` / `hoursEnd` are `LocalTime` (`HH:mm:ss`). End must be strictly after start (returns 400 otherwise).

The configured hours drive the **out-of-hours indicator** in chat (PRD §6.1).

Sets the nursery geofence center (lat/lng) and radius in metres (10–2000). Used by parent check-in to enable/disable the check-in button (PRD §6.1 attendance).

Defaults from the PRD: radius 100m, +10m drift tolerance applied at check-in time.

item.name: Rooms
item.description: CRUD for rooms within the admin's nursery. Names must be unique among active (non-archived) rooms (case-insensitive). Soft-archive preserves history.

request.description:
Create a room within the current admin's nursery.

**Body**
- `name` (required, max 100, unique among active rooms case-insensitive)
- `capacity` (optional, min 1)

**Response (201)** auto-saves the new room id into `{{roomId}}`.

Returns 409 if a non-archived room with the same name already exists.

query.description: Set true to include soft-archived rooms

request.description: List rooms in the current nursery, ordered by name. Set `includeArchived=true` to include soft-archived rooms; defaults to active only.
Fetch a single room by id. Returns 404 if the room does not exist or belongs to a different nursery (cross-tenant access is treated as not-found).

Partial update of an active room. Any field may be omitted.

Returns 409 if:
- the new name clashes with another active room, or
- the room is archived (restore it first).
Soft-archive the room (sets `archivedAt = now`). The row is preserved so historical references (children, daily logs, attendance) remain intact. Use **Restore Room** to bring it back.
Un-archive a previously archived room (clears `archivedAt`). Fails with 409 if a different active room now uses the same name — rename the archived room first or rename the active one.

item.name: Teachers
item.description: Assign teachers to rooms. A teacher can be assigned to multiple rooms; a room can have multiple teachers. The teacher must already exist in this nursery (invited via `Admin / Invites / Create Invite` with role `TEACHER`).

request.description: Attach an existing TEACHER user to a room. Returns 201, 404 if room/teacher not in this nursery, 400 if the user is not a teacher, 409 if already assigned or the room is archived.
List teachers assigned to a specific room, ordered by assignment date.
List rooms a specific teacher is assigned to.
Remove a teacher from a room. Returns 204 on success, 404 if no such assignment.

item.name: Children
item.description: Enrollment: create child profiles, assign to rooms, manage guardians, authorized pickups, and emergency contacts. Photo upload is per-child. Unenroll soft-revokes the child and removes them from parent self-service queries; the row + linked data are retained for history.

body.raw:
{
  "fullName": "Yara Ahmed",
  "dob": "2022-03-15",
  "roomId": "{{roomId}}",
  "allergies": "Peanuts",
  "medicalNotes": "Mild asthma — inhaler in bag",
  "immunizations": "MMR (2023-04), DTaP (2023-09)"
}

request.description:
Create a child profile in the admin's nursery.

**Body**
- `fullName` (required, max 200)
- `dob` (required, ISO date, must be in the past)
- `roomId` (optional) — must reference an active room in this nursery
- `allergies`, `medicalNotes`, `immunizations` (optional free text, max 2000 each)

**Response (201)** auto-saves the new child id into `{{childId}}`.

query.description: Set true to include unenrolled children

request.description: List children in the current nursery, ordered by full name. Optional query params: `roomId` (filter by room), `includeUnenrolled` (default false).
Fetch a single child by id. Returns 404 if the child does not exist or belongs to another nursery.
Partial update of profile fields. Room assignment goes through **Reassign Room**; enrollment status goes through **Unenroll** / **Restore**.
Move a child to a different room. Pass `roomId: null` to detach. Target room must be active in this nursery.

Set `enrollmentStatus = UNENROLLED` and record `unenrolledAt`. Hides the child from parent self-service immediately (PRD §6.3). Guardian links remain in DB for historical reference but no longer expose data.
Re-enroll a previously unenrolled child (clears `unenrolledAt`). Parent access via existing guardian links becomes visible again.

Upload a child's profile photo (multipart). Accepts `image/jpeg`, `image/png`, or `image/webp`, max 5 MB. Replaces any existing photo.

**Storage** is local disk for dev (`./uploads/children/{id}.{ext}` under the configured root). The returned child shape has `photoUrl` set to `/api/files/children/{id}/photo` — call that with an auth header to download bytes.

Errors: 400 (no file), 413 (>5 MB), 415 (wrong content type).
Remove the child's profile photo from disk and clear `photoKey`. Returns 204 even if no photo was set.
Stream the child's photo. Requires auth. Access: ADMIN/TEACHER in the same nursery, OR a PARENT with an active guardian link to this child. Anyone else gets 404.

Single-call guardian onboarding (option A).

- If the email is **new**: creates a PARENT user (disabled), attaches to this nursery, issues an invite token (48h), and links them to the child. Response has `newInvite: true` and `inviteToken` set — share with the parent so they can call `Auth / Accept Invite`. The test script saves `{{inviteToken}}` and `{{guardianId}}`.
- If a PARENT user with that email **already exists** in this nursery: links them directly. Response has `newInvite: false` and null invite fields.

**Body**
- `email` (required)
- `fullName` (required when inviting; ignored when linking existing)
- `relationship` (required, free text — "Mother", "Father", "Grandmother", etc.)
- `isPrimary` (optional, default false)
- `locale`, `phone` (optional, for invite flow)

**Errors**: 409 if email belongs to another nursery, 409 if email is registered with a non-parent role, 409 if guardian already linked to this child.
List all guardians linked to a child (ordered by link creation time).
Remove the guardian-child link. The parent user account is NOT deleted.
Add an authorized pickup contact. The test script saves the new id into `{{pickupId}}`.
Full replace of pickup details (all fields required).
Add an emergency contact (distinct from authorized pickups). The test script saves the new id into `{{emergencyContactId}}`.

item.name: Invites
item.description: Onboarding flow: admin creates an invite for a teacher or parent, then shares the returned one-time token with them so they can call `Auth / Accept Invite` to set a password.

request.description:
Creates a new user invite. Requires the caller to have role ADMIN. The invited user is auto-attached to the inviting admin's nursery.

**Body**
- `email` (required, valid email, max 254)
- `fullName` (required, max 200)
- `role` (required) — `ADMIN`, `TEACHER`, or `PARENT`. `SUPER_ADMIN` is rejected (400).
- `locale` (optional) — `EN` or `AR`, defaults to `EN`.
- `phone` (optional, max 32)

Admins may invite **other admins** within their own nursery (co-admins / owner+manager pattern). To onboard the *first* admin of a brand-new nursery, use `Super Admin / Invite Admin`.

**Response (201)** contains the invited `userId` and a one-time `token` to share with the invitee for `POST /api/auth/accept-invite`. The test script auto-saves both into `{{userId}}` and `{{inviteToken}}`.

Returns 409 if the email already exists.

item.name: Users
item.description: Account control: enable/disable users without rotating credentials. Disabling is the canonical revocation mechanism for non-expiring access tokens.

request.description:
Disable a user account. Requires role ADMIN.

**Effect**: sets `enabled = false` and revokes all of the user's refresh tokens. The next API call from that user with their existing access token will fail (401), since `JwtAuthFilter` checks `enabled` on every request.

Returns 400 if you try to disable your own account.

Re-enable a previously disabled user account. Requires role ADMIN.

The user must log in again to obtain a new token (their refresh tokens were revoked at disable time).

item.name: Daily Logs
item.description: Read-only oversight of daily logs across the nursery. Admins see both DRAFT and PUBLISHED entries (unlike parents). Teacher endpoints handle authoring.

request.description: Summaries of every daily log for a specific child, newest date first. Each row has `totalEntries` (DRAFT + PUBLISHED) and `publishedEntries` counts.
Full daily log with all entries (DRAFT + PUBLISHED). Cross-tenant access returns 404.

item.name: Attendance
item.description: Manual check-in/out and roster views for admins. Source on admin events is `ADMIN_MANUAL`. No geofence check for admin actions.

request.description: Records an admin-initiated check-in for the child. Body is optional; `notes` (max 500) is stored on the event for audit. Returns the child's full attendance state for today.
Records an admin-initiated check-out. Same shape as check-in.

query.description: ISO date (interpreted in the nursery's timezone)
Optional — filter to a single room

request.description: Returns every enrolled child in the nursery with their attendance status for the requested date: `NOT_ARRIVED`, `PRESENT`, or `CHECKED_OUT`. Each row also carries `lastCheckInAt` / `lastCheckOutAt` and the raw event list for that day. Filter to a single room with `roomId`.
Day-by-day summary for one child between `from` and `to` (inclusive). Useful for the admin's attendance history page in Figma. The FE can compute weekend/absent rendering from the response.

item.name: Incidents
item.description: Admin-side incident reporting. PRD §6.3: 'Receive instant notification on each incident · View all incident reports across all rooms · Track parent acknowledgment per incident'. Admins can create, edit anytime (no author/ack restriction), and view ack rollup per guardian. Retained 2+ years (no delete API).

request.description:
Create an incident report for a child in this nursery. Saves a snapshot of the child's current room. Fires `IncidentReportedEvent` (the Notifications slice will fan out to all linked guardians + other admins).

**Body**
- `incidentAt` (required ISO instant, must be past or now)
- `description` (required, max 2000)
- `actionTaken` (optional, max 2000)
- `injuryArea` (optional, max 100) — set only when injury involved

**Response (201)** auto-saves the new incident id into `{{incidentId}}`.
Admins can edit incidents at any time, even after parent acknowledgment. (Teachers, by contrast, can only edit their own incidents that haven't been acknowledged yet.)
Every incident in the nursery, newest first. Each row has total linked guardians and acknowledged count for quick sorting on the admin incident log.
Per-guardian acknowledgment status for an incident. One row per current guardian of the child with `acknowledged: true/false` and `acknowledgedAt`. Drives the Figma 'seen / not seen' chip.

item.name: Media
item.description:
Photos and videos uploaded by staff. PRD §6.2 (teacher uploads per child or per room, bulk), §6.3 (admin can delete any media anytime). Soft-deleted rows are retained for the 30-day post-unenrollment grace window. Storage is local disk for dev; the same MediaStorage abstraction will swap to S3 in prod.

**Accepted types**: `image/jpeg`, `image/png`, `image/webp` (≤5 MB); `video/mp4`, `video/quicktime` (≤50 MB).

formdata.description: Optional caption applied to all files in this upload

request.description:
Bulk upload — pass multiple `files` parts. Returns `{uploaded:[...], failed:[{filename, reason}]}`. Per-file failures are reported individually; the upload is **not all-or-nothing** (PRD: lose 4 photos because file #5 was HEIC would be bad UX).

The test script saves the first uploaded id into `{{mediaId}}` so subsequent requests can target it.
Room-scoped upload. Visible to every parent whose enrolled child currently belongs to this room (later joiners see historical media; earlier leavers lose access).
Soft delete (sets `deleted_at`). Admins can delete any media anytime; teachers are restricted to their own uploads within 24 h.
Child-scoped media (not the parent's full gallery — admin sees just media where `child_id == :childId`).
All non-deleted media in the nursery, newest first. Useful for admin oversight.

item.name: Announcements
item.description: Admin can post nursery-wide or room-scoped announcements with text + links + attached media (PRD §6.3). Attachments reuse existing MediaItem rows — upload via `Admin / Media / Upload For Child` first, then pass the `id`s in `attachmentMediaIds`. Returns `seenCount` per announcement; full per-user breakdown via `/seen-by`.

body.raw:
{
  "scope": "NURSERY",
  "title": "Half-day Wednesday",
  "body": "Pick-up at 12:00 this Wednesday for staff training.",
  "links": ["https://sunshine.local/calendar"],
  "attachmentMediaIds": []
}

request.description: Set `scope: "ROOM"` and provide `roomId` for room-targeted announcements. Saves the new id into `{{announcementId}}`.
Partial update. `attachmentMediaIds` replaces the full attachment list when provided (pass empty array to remove all).
Hard delete (no retention rule like incidents). Cascades the announcement_links and announcement_attachments rows but does NOT delete the underlying media.

query.description: Optional — filter to a single room

request.description: All announcements in the nursery, newest first. PRD §6.3 'Filter announcements by room' satisfied by the optional roomId query param.

Per-user breakdown of who has opened this announcement (PRD §6.3 'Seen-by count per announcement'). One row per user that's marked it seen, with `seenAt` timestamp. The list endpoint already returns just the `seenCount` for quick sorting.

item.name: Events
item.description: Events are admin-authored only (PRD §6.3). Types: `ONE_TIME`, `RECURRING` (requires `recurrenceRule` RFC5545 RRULE), `HOLIDAY`, `PARENT_TEACHER_MEETING`. Server stores recurrence verbatim — the mobile/web client expands occurrences for calendar rendering.

body.raw:
{
  "scope": "NURSERY",
  "eventType": "ONE_TIME",
  "title": "Sports Day",
  "description": "Annual sports day at the back garden.",
  "location": "Sunshine Nursery — back garden",
  "startsAt": "2026-06-15T09:00:00Z",
  "endsAt": "2026-06-15T12:00:00Z"
}

request.description: Saves new id into `{{eventId}}`.

query.description: Set true to only return events with `startsAt >= now`

item.name: Teacher
item.description:
Teacher-only endpoints. Each teacher can only act on children whose current room they're assigned to via `Admin / Teachers / Assign Teacher to Room`. Cross-room access returns 404.

**Publish model**: each `LogEntry` carries its own `publishedAt` state. Teachers can publish entries individually OR batch-publish all DRAFT entries in a daily log. Each publish event fires `DailyLogEntriesPublishedEvent` — the Notifications slice (later) will fan that out to push.

body.raw:
{
  "date": "2026-05-22",
  "category": "MEAL",
  "entryTime": "12:30:00",
  "title": "Lunch",
  "detail": "Ate all the rice and chicken, drank water",
  "napMinutes": null,
  "publish": false
}

request.description:
Add a log entry for a child. The system creates today's `DailyLog` if none exists yet, then attaches the entry.

**Body**
- `date` (required, ISO date, past-or-present)
- `category` (required) — `MOOD`, `MEAL`, `NAP`, `DIAPER`, `ACTIVITY`, `MEDICATION`
- `entryTime` (required, `HH:mm:ss`)
- `title` (required, max 200)
- `detail` (optional, max 2000)
- `napMinutes` (optional integer, useful for NAP entries)
- `publish` (optional bool, default false) — set true to publish immediately and fire the notification event in the same call

**Response (201)** auto-saves the new entry id into `{{logEntryId}}` and the daily log id into `{{dailyLogId}}`.
Partial update. Cannot change `date`/`dailyLog`; if the entry has been published, edits do NOT re-fire a notification — call **Publish Entry** again if needed.
Permanently remove a log entry. Any teacher assigned to the child's room may delete (PRD doesn't restrict to original author).
Mark a single entry as published. Fires `DailyLogEntriesPublishedEvent` (event payload includes the entry id, log id, child id). No-op if already published.
Revert a published entry to DRAFT. Parent loses access immediately. No event fired.

Publish multiple DRAFT entries in one call — useful for end-of-day flow. Fires ONE event with all entry ids (the Notifications slice can debounce into a single push).

**Body**
- `entryIds` (optional) — list of specific entry ids to publish. Pass `null` or omit to publish ALL currently-DRAFT entries in the log.
Full log with all entries (DRAFT + PUBLISHED). Teacher must be assigned to the child's current room.

item.name: Get Log for Child by Date

request.description: Fetch the daily log for a specific (child, date). Returns 404 if no log exists yet (i.e. teacher hasn't added any entries that day).
Summaries for every child in the teacher's room for a given date. Each entry shows total + published counts so the teacher can spot drafts that still need publishing.

item.name: Attendance
item.description: Teacher attendance — manual check-in/out for children whose parents didn't use the app (PRD §6.2 'Manual attendance mark'), plus the live room roster. No geofence check; source is `TEACHER_MANUAL`.

request.description: Manual check-in for a child in the teacher's assigned room. Body is optional. Returns the child's full attendance state for today.
Manual check-out for a child in the teacher's assigned room.

Live attendance roster for the room on the given date. One row per enrolled child with `status`, `lastCheckInAt`, `lastCheckOutAt`, and the full event timeline. Backs the teacher's 'all / present / not arrived' filter from the Figma.

item.name: Incidents
item.description: PRD §6.2: 'Separate structured form from daily log. On submit: admin notified immediately, parent receives formal notification. Parent acknowledgment tracked (seen / not seen).' Teacher can create + view incidents for children in their assigned rooms, and edit only their own incidents that no parent has acknowledged yet.

request.description: Same shape as the admin endpoint, but the teacher must be assigned to the child's current room. Author is recorded as the teacher. The test script saves `{{incidentId}}`.
Edit only allowed if: (a) you authored this incident AND (b) no parent has acknowledged it yet. 403 if not author, 409 if already acknowledged (ask an admin to edit after acknowledgement).
Per-guardian ack status — lets the teacher see whether the parent has read the report (useful before raising it again at pickup).

item.name: Media
item.description: Teacher photo/video uploads per child or per room. Teachers can only target children in their assigned rooms, and can only delete their **own** uploads within **24 h** (PRD §6.2). After that window, ask an admin.

request.description: Bulk upload for one child. Same response shape as the admin endpoint; the test script saves `{{mediaId}}`.
Returns 403 if you're not the uploader, 409 if the 24-hour window has elapsed.

item.name: Announcements
item.description: Teachers can only post ROOM-scoped announcements (PRD §6.2 'Post room-level announcements — their room only'). Edit/delete restricted to own posts. Events are admin-only and not exposed here.

body.raw:
{
  "scope": "ROOM",
  "roomId": "{{roomId}}",
  "title": "Bring a hat tomorrow",
  "body": "We'll be outside most of the day, please send a hat with your child.",
  "links": [],
  "attachmentMediaIds": []
}

request.description: 400 if `scope != ROOM` or `roomId` missing. 404 if teacher isn't assigned to that room. Saves the new id into `{{announcementId}}`.
403 if not the author.
403 if not the author.

item.name: Parent
item.description: Parent self-service endpoints. Requires role PARENT. Lists children the parent is linked to via `GuardianLink` and the child is still enrolled (`enrollmentStatus = ENROLLED`). Unenrolled children disappear from these endpoints immediately.

request.description: Returns the currently authenticated parent's enrolled children (one row per child, ordered by link creation date).

Returns the child profile plus authorized pickups and emergency contacts. Returns 404 if the parent isn't linked to this child OR the child is unenrolled (deliberately the same code so we don't leak existence).

Returns the child's daily log for the specified date — **published entries only** (DRAFT entries are invisible to parents). Returns 404 if no log exists for that date, or the parent isn't linked, or the child is unenrolled.
Day-by-day summaries between `from` and `to` (inclusive) with at least one published entry. Each entry shows the published count; drill into a date via **Daily Log for Date** to see full entries.

Returns the parent's nursery profile: name, logo, timezone, opening hours, geofence center + radius. The mobile app uses `geofenceLat`/`geofenceLng`/`geofenceRadiusM` to gray out the Check In button when the device is outside the radius. Server still validates on POST — see PRD §7 (geofence).

Parent-app check-in. **Server-side geofence enforcement** (PRD §7): the request fails with 403 if the GPS coordinates are outside the nursery's configured radius + 10 m drift buffer. Returns 409 if the nursery hasn't configured geofence yet.

**Body**
- `lat` (required, -90..90)
- `lng` (required, -180..180)
- `accuracyM` (optional positive — passed through to the audit row)

Source on the resulting event is `PARENT_APP`.
Parent-app check-out. Same shape and geofence behaviour as check-in.
Today's (or any past day's) attendance state for one of the parent's children: status, last check-in/out times, and the full event list for that day.

One row per calendar day in the range with status + last check-in/out. Drives the parent attendance-history calendar in the Figma — FE renders weekend cells from the dates themselves, absent cells from `status = NOT_ARRIVED`.
All incidents for one of the parent's linked enrolled children, newest first. Each row carries `acknowledged: true/false` and `acknowledgedAt` for the calling parent specifically.
Full incident detail. Returns 404 if the parent isn't linked or the child is unenrolled (same code on purpose — no existence leak).

Mark the incident as 'seen' for the calling parent. Idempotent — second call is a no-op (acknowledgedAt stays the original timestamp). Fires `IncidentAcknowledgedEvent` only on the first ack so the admin notification doesn't repeat.

Parent's per-child gallery. Aggregates **two** sources, both filtered to non-deleted items:
- Child-scoped media (uploaded directly to this child)
- Room-scoped media for the child's current room (so a 'Sunflower room party' upload shows up for every Sunflower kid's parent)

Results are merged and sorted newest-first. View-only — parents cannot delete (PRD §6.1). 404 if the child is unenrolled or the parent isn't linked.

Returns all announcements visible to this parent: nursery-wide ones AND any room-scoped ones for rooms their enrolled children currently belong to. Each row carries `seenByMe` + `seenByMeAt` (no auto-mark; that happens only on `GET /{id}`).
Full detail with attachments resolved. **First call** for this announcement+parent pair inserts an `announcement_seen` row (so admin's `seenCount` ticks up). Subsequent calls are no-ops.

query.description: Set true to filter to `startsAt >= now`

request.description: Nursery-wide + room-targeted events for the parent's children's rooms. Each row has `savedByMe` for the Figma 'saved' chip.
Idempotent — second call is a no-op (savedAt remains the original timestamp).
Backs the Figma 'Saved' events tab in the parent app.

item.name: Me
item.description:
Cross-role endpoints scoped to the authenticated user. The notification center backs the Figma 'Notifications' screen (mark-as-read, delete-all). Preferences include PRD §6.1 'Toggle announcement notifications on/off' and 'Quiet hours setting'.

**Quiet hours** are stored but not yet enforced — they take effect once push delivery is wired up (deferred to a follow-up).

request.description: All non-deleted notifications for the current user, newest first. Test script saves the first id into `{{notificationId}}`.
Returns `{ unread: <number> }`. Use this for the badge on the parent home screen.
Idempotent — second call returns the same `readAt` timestamp.
Returns the resulting `unread` count (should be 0).
Soft delete — sets `deleted_at`. The row is hidden from list endpoints but retained for audit.
Backs the Figma 'Delete All' button on the notifications screen. Soft-deletes every non-deleted notification for the caller.
Returns current preferences or defaults (`announcementsEnabled: true`, quiet hours null) if the user hasn't customized them yet.

Partial update. Any field may be omitted. Set `clearQuietHours: true` to wipe the window. Stored as `LocalTime` (no date); push delivery will compute the in-window check against the user's nursery timezone when wired up.

item.name: Files
item.description: Authenticated binary downloads. URLs are emitted by other endpoints (e.g. `photoUrl`, `fileUrl`). Access is role-aware and re-checked on each request.

request.description: Stream the child's profile photo (set via `Admin / Children / Upload Photo`). Returns 404 if no photo or no access.

Stream a media item (photo or video). Access rules:
- ADMIN: any media in same nursery
- TEACHER: media whose scope room matches one of their assignments (room-scoped media, or child-scoped media for children in their assigned rooms)
- PARENT: media linked to one of their children OR room-scoped media for the child's current room

Returns 404 for cross-nursery, deleted, or unauthorized access (deliberately the same code — no existence leak).
